h2: Dubai Real Estate News Today & Investment Intelligence
h3: Stay ahead with expert analysis on regulatory changes, market trends, and investment strategies. We translate complex dubai property market data into actionable intelligence for every investor—from first-time buyers to portfolio managers seeking the best real estate investment in dubai.
trust_statement: All content is verified against official Dubai Land Department (DLD), RERA, and UAE government sources. Updated regularly to reflect current dubai property market forecast and regulatory developments.

cards.headline: How to Buy Freehold Property in Dubai as a Foreign Investor
cards.summary: Non-UAE nationals can acquire freehold ownership rights only in designated areas determined by Regulation No. (3) of 2006. This guide covers eligible zones including Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, JVC, and Arabian Ranches—plus the difference between freehold, usufruct, and long-term leasehold rights.
cards.key_takeaway: Always confirm the specific plot lies within a Designated Area through official DLD maps or a RERA-registered broker.

cards.headline: Complete Guide to Off Plan Projects in UAE for 2026
cards.summary: Off plan property purchases represent over 71% of Dubai's 2026 sales volume. This guide explains advantages (lower entry prices, flexible payment plans, capital appreciation) versus risks (completion delays, market fluctuations). Learn how to verify developer credentials, understand escrow protections, and evaluate projects.
cards.key_takeaway: Only invest in projects with verified escrow accounts and RERA-registered developers with proven delivery history.

cards.headline: Golden Visa Properties: Secure 10-Year UAE Residency Through Real Estate
cards.summary: The UAE Golden Visa offers 10-year renewable residency to investors who purchase property worth at least AED 2,000,000. This can be achieved through a single or multiple properties. Benefits include no minimum stay, family sponsorship, and zero local taxes on rental income.
cards.key_takeaway: If you sell the qualifying property, residency status may be affected unless another qualifying investment is maintained.

cards.headline: Understanding Dubai Properties Service Charges & Mollak System
cards.summary: RERA's Mollak system governs annual service charges covering maintenance, security, and community facilities. Charges vary: Emaar (AED 15-22/sq.ft), Sobha (AED 14-18/sq.ft), affordable developments (AED 10-16/sq.ft). For 1,000 sq.ft, expect AED 10,000-22,000 annually.
cards.key_takeaway: Always verify a community's historical service charge per square foot before purchasing to accurately forecast your ROI.

cards.headline: Oqood Registration Process: Protecting Your Off-Plan Investment
cards.summary: Oqood is Dubai's interim real estate register where off plan property sales must be registered within 90 days of signing the SPA. This provisional registration legally secures ownership rights during construction before a final title deed is issued. DLD charges approximately AED 1,000.
cards.key_takeaway: Verify Oqood registration status before making any payment beyond the initial booking fee.

cards.headline: Best Areas to Invest in Dubai for 2026: ROI & Capital Growth
cards.summary: For rental yield (7-9%): JVC, Dubai South, and Arjan lead. For capital appreciation: Dubai Creek Harbour, Dubai South, and Dubai Islands show strong potential. For stability: Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and Palm Jumeirah offer established infrastructure and proven demand.
cards.key_takeaway: Villas and townhouses are forecast to outperform apartments in 2026, with projected price growth of 17.7% versus 7.4%.

cards.headline: Escrow Account Real Estate Dubai: How Your Funds Are Protected
cards.summary: All buyer payments for off plan projects must be deposited in project-specific escrow accounts. Funds are released only against verified construction milestones, monitored by RERA. In cases of formal cancellation, amounts must be returned within 60 days.
cards.key_takeaway: Always verify the project's escrow account number and bank before transferring any funds.

cards.headline: Selling Off Plan Property Before Completion: Rules & Procedures
cards.summary: Selling off plan property before handover is permitted, subject to developer consent and a transfer fee (often 2-4%). The property must be registered under Oqood, and outstanding payments must be settled or negotiated. This provides an exit strategy if market conditions change.
cards.key_takeaway: Review your SPA's resale clause before purchasing, as developer policies on pre-handover sales vary.

cards.headline: Total Dubai Land Department Fees When Buying Property
cards.summary: Principal fees include: DLD Transfer Fee (4%), Title Deed Issuance (AED 250-580), Trustee Office Fee (AED 4,000 + VAT), agency commission (2% + VAT), and developer NOC fees (AED 500-5,000). Budget 7-10% above purchase price for all transaction expenses.
cards.key_takeaway: The 4% DLD transfer fee is legally split 2% buyer/2% seller, but commonly paid in full by the buyer in practice.

cards.headline: Payment Plan Property Dubai: Structures & Off Plan Mortgage Options
cards.summary: Common structures include 50/50, 60/40, and 80/20 plans. Emaar typically offers 10/90 or 20/80 where the final portion is due on handover. Off plan mortgage options require higher down payments (25-50%) compared to ready properties.
cards.key_takeaway: Post-handover payment plans are less common among top-tier developers—verify the full schedule before committing.
